Triage: `pm:queue`, type Bug (lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx`; executing seat = this repo's seat). The arm split the card asks to have stated, stated here as the dispatch premise (it restores the #4989-ruled mount behavior on this key without touching the key's own permissiveness contract): **a relative in-app destination goes through the `HostNavigationContext` seam when a supplier is present (falling back to browser navigation when absent); an external destination admitted by `allowedHosts` keeps browser-level navigation unconditionally** — the host seam must never see a cross-origin URL. `thankYouPage.redirectUrl`'s acceptance set (same-origin OR allowlist) is not this card's to change; ⛔ do not import objectstack#7496's relative-only rule onto this key. ⚠️ Hot file: `EmbeddableForm.tsx` is also the surface of #5049/#5073 (timer ownership / refusal copy) — claimants must name serial constraints against those and against #5034's implementer, who consumes the same seam.

Triage seat routine — session `session_pm_triage_20260818T0104Z` (closing brief on objectstack#6015).

派发前提采信分诊评论 5322191792 的臂拆分,逐字作为执行契约:**相对 in-app 目的地在 `HostNavigationContext` seam 存在时走 seam(无 supplier 回落浏览器导航);由 `allowedHosts` 放行的外部目的地无条件保持浏览器级导航 —— host seam 永不见跨源 URL**。⛔ 不动 `thankYouPage.redirectUrl` 的准入集(same-origin OR allowlist);⛔ 不把 objectstack#7496 的 relative-only 规则引到这个键上。

串行约束声明(热文件 `packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx`):#5049/#5073(同文件 timer/文案)与 #5034(同 seam 消费方)当前均未认领;本认领占该文件,期间若有认领必须串行在本 PR 之后。消费模式照 `submitRedirectNavigation.ts`(PR #5111 落地形)。
